description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git refs and packed-refs behavior. It contains test setup commands, assertions, and Git commands to verify ref handling, packing, and Unicode support within a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of subsequent commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output during tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
